name: OX Quiz Widget
description: Mobile-first educational OX (True/False) quiz widget that presents one question at a time with O/X selection, instant feedback with explanations, progress tracking, and retry support.

requirement.summary: Build an OX quiz interface for an educational mobile app where users answer a list of questions one at a time by choosing O or X, see the correct answer with an explanation after each choice, track progress, and restart the quiz when finished.
details: Display the quiz question list one question at a time
Provide O and X answer buttons for the user to select
After selection, show whether the answer is correct or incorrect along with the correct answer and an explanation
Disable or lock the answer buttons after an answer is selected, and provide a control to advance to the next question
Display progress as completed/total (e.g., '3/10 문제 완료') with a visual progress bar
Show a completion summary (e.g., number of correct answers out of total) when all questions are answered
Provide a retry (다시 풀기) function that resets all state and restarts from the first question
Responsive layout for mobile and tablet screen sizes
Transition animations between questions and when revealing results, using Tailwind transition/animation utilities
Keyboard accessibility: all controls reachable via Tab, activated via Enter/Space, with optional shortcuts (e.g., 'O' key and 'X' key for answers, Enter for next), visible focus indicators
Use ARIA attributes (e.g., aria-live region for result feedback, aria-pressed on answer buttons, role='progressbar' with aria-valuenow/aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax on the progress bar)
Color scheme: green for correct, red for incorrect, gray for neutral/unanswered states
Use the system default font stack

Component structure: QuizContainer (overall layout and state owner), QuestionCard (current question display), AnswerButtons (O/X selection), ProgressBar (progress indicator), ResultDisplay (correct/incorrect feedback and explanation)
State management: current question index, user's selected answer, correctness of the answer, and quiz completion status (plus accumulated score for the summary)
Question data model: id, question text, correct answer ('O' | 'X'), and explanation; accept questions via props with sample data provided for the demo
Style exclusively with Tailwind CSS utility classes, no external CSS or UI libraries
